title: Wave-end scene manifest
description: Schema for scenes.json, the wave-end-tagged subset of the DX-101 rig registry (Tools/visual-regression/lib/rig-registry.mjs) flattened into the shape capture-and-diff.mjs reads. Generated text: generateScenesJson(loadRigs()) in lib/rig-registry.mjs must equal this file's sibling scenes.json byte-for-byte; this schema describes that generated shape, not the rig record shape (see rigs/<id>.mjs for that).

description.description: Schema-level prose describing the manifest's own fields; not a scene description.

baseUrl.description: Origin-bearing URL of the split-screen comparison page every scene captures against. Mirrors every wave-end rig's `url` field (rig-registry.mjs asserts they all agree).

settleFrames.description: Frames to render before capture, applied to every scene. Mirrors every wave-end rig's `readiness.frames` (rig-registry.mjs asserts they all agree).

setupFile.description: Path (relative to this directory) of a JS module evaluated in the page context before the camera is applied.

setupParams.description: Free-form parameters passed to `setupFile`. Mirrors the rig's `setupParams` field verbatim.

destination.description: [longitudeDegrees, latitudeDegrees, heightMetres]. Derived from a rig's degrees-form camera ({lon,lat,height}); a rig using the ECEF-pose form ({position,direction,up}) or no static pose at all renders as `null` here instead — this shape cannot hold an ECEF pose (see voxel-box-procedural).

expect.description: lib/visual-gate-policy.mjs GateExpectation. UNMEASURED is a first-class value, not a placeholder.

trackedBy.description: Required when expect is FAIL: the tracker id carrying the known defect.
